runs.text: Tue – Sun · 5 pm – 11 pm · 214 Wythe Ave
A small kitchen with a long memory
Chef Giulia Ferro rolls every sheet of pasta by hand each morning, following recipes from her grandmother’s trattoria in Bologna. Our wine list favours small growers who farm without shortcuts.
Please tell your server about any allergies.
Walk-ins welcome at the bar. Parties of seven or more, please call ahead.
